source.name: installgentoo.net (4chan Archiver)
source.short-desc: installgentoo.net was one of the earliest Fuuka archivers, with posts dating back to 2011. Obtained from RebeccaBlackTech for the Bibliotheca Anonoma from an unknown source, and uploaded to the Internet Archive in November 2015. The dump was sanitized before release: password hashes are all 'hunter2' and IP addresses are all 0.0.0.0, but the thread data is unchanged.
source.capture: 25GB, of which only the 2.4GB installgentoo-mysql-2014-02-22.tar.xz is text; archive-2-22-14.tar.gz (22.7GB) is thumbnails and is excluded. TWO NAMING TRAPS in that one file. First, the item description calls it 'installgentoo-2014-02-22.tar.xz' — that name does not exist in the item, it is the name of the .sql INSIDE. Second, and the one that breaks prepare steps written from the filename: despite the .tar.xz extension the file is BZIP2, magic 'BZh9', which is why IA reports its format as Unknown and why `tar xJf` fails on it. Plain `tar xf` auto-detects and works. It unpacks to TWO mysqldumps, not one: installgentoo-2014-02-22.sql (9.98GB, database `fuuka`, the posts) and installgentoo-admin-2014-02-22.sql (16KB, database `fuuka_admin` — banlist, loginattempts, modlog, reports, staff). The admin dump holds no post tables, so an adapter's column test skips it and staging both is harmless. THREE BOARDS ONLY: diy, g, sci, each with the Fuuka side tables (_daily, _images, _threads, _users), plus index_counters. ADAPTER IS sql, over dumps `prepare` rewrites from original Fuuka to Asagi. The reader recognises board tables by requiring num, subnum, thread_num, timestamp, comment. This dump is ORIGINAL Fuuka, whose board tables carry `parent` where Asagi has `thread_num`, with no thread_num column at all: doc_id, id, num, subnum, parent, timestamp, preview, preview_w, preview_h, media, media_w, media_h, media_size, media_hash, media_filename, spoiler, deleted, capcode, email, name, trip, title, comment, delpass, sticky. Run UNCONVERTED over a 300MB slice, an Asagi reader accepted zero tables and ingested zero posts — it does not error, it silently does nothing, which is exactly how this would slip past a run judged by exit code. That is what the header rename in prepare exists to prevent. laza-4chan-archive, also called 'Fuuka', is really Asagi (`thread_num`). CORRECTION: the conclusion that this needed a new adapter, or a `parent` alias in the reader, was wrong — warosu is the SAME original-Fuuka schema, so one header rename in prepare serves both. Warosu's board tables match column-for-column (doc_id, id, num, subnum, parent, timestamp, preview, preview_w, preview_h, media, media_w, media_h, media_size, media_hash, media_filename, spoiler, deleted, capcode, email, name, trip, title, comment, delpass, sticky) and the columns the rename targets (`parent`, `media`, `media_filename`) are all present here. Verified on a 400MB slice: accepted exactly [diy, g], rejected every _daily/_images/_threads/_users side table, 1,346,784 posts with zero null timestamps, OP ratios of 5.9-7%, and bodies that read as real /g/ prose (90.5% contain words; the 1.5% numeric-only ones are genuine posts, not misaligned columns). The one schema difference — `parent` is nullable here versus NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 on warosu — is harmless, since a SQL NULL parses to JS null and Number(null) is 0, the same value warosu uses to mean OP. Timestamps are still New-York wall time, so whatever reads it needs nyWallToUtc as usual.
